id: title:Piccirello:restrict local plugin installs to development

review.posthog_relevance: Blocks plugin installation from local filesystem URLs in non-debug environments, preventing potential supply-chain or local-path injection attacks.
review.reason: Adds a runtime check and corresponding test: P1.F2.H1 introduces a `ValidationError` when a plugin URL starts with 'file:' and the environment is not DEBUG, while P1.F1.H3 tests this rejection behavior. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and security improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual production impact and whether this specific supply-chain attack vector has been realized or exploited are not demonstrated by the code alone; the benefit is potential rather than realized.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a test and implementation change. P1.F1.H3 adds a test, P1.F2.H1 adds the enforcement. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a check in P1.F2.H1: if URL starts with 'file:' and DEBUG is False, raise ValidationError.
observations.posthog_connection: Blocks plugin installation from local filesystem URLs in non-debug environments, preventing potential supply-chain or local-path injection attacks.

observations.behavior: Adds a test in P1.F1.H3: POSTs a URL with 'file:' scheme and expects 400 status.
observations.posthog_connection: Tests the rejection behavior of the new security check.
